images.screen: A · 해 질 녘 협상 테이블 (차 밑 통행 협정)
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. A strategy-diplomacy game screen. Left two thirds: a high-angle rooftop view of a dense residential alley neighborhood at dusk, drawn as a stylized painterly map: green-painted flat rooftops with orange and blue plastic water tanks and laundry lines, blue slate and red clay tile roofs, a small church roof with a red cross, a fish shop with a red-and-white striped awning, parked cars in the asphalt alley, warm streetlamps coming on. Five translucent colored territory zones with animated dashed borders (amber, teal, coral, lavender, moss green) mark cat faction turf; small black cat silhouettes sit on the roofs. A glowing ring highlights the space under a white sedan with the tag '흰 소나타 밑 — 협상 대상'. Right panel: a cream paper treaty card titled '차 밑 통행 협정' with two cute round cat portrait medallions (a black cat and a fat orange tabby) and an orange button '발도장 찍기', below it a list of five faction leader portraits with trust bars. Bottom: a timeline of human feeding times. Top HUD: '골목 고양이 정치', amber clock '17:42'. Warm violet-orange dusk palette, soft grain, vignette.

images.screen: B · 비 오는 밤의 배신 (발톱 자국)
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. The same rooftop alley map at night in the rain: deep navy and slate tones, lit amber windows, pools of sodium streetlight, rain streaks and puddle reflections. The teal faction territory has pushed across its dashed border into the fish shop's coral zone, shown by a teal dashed invasion arrow, and three bright red glowing claw-scratch slashes are torn across the broken border. A red banner in the upper left reads '까망이 협정을 깼다'. Right panel: the same cream treaty card now torn, crossed out and slashed by three deep claw marks, with a red rubber stamp '파기' and a black cat portrait; below it a red-tinted permanent-record box and three response choices, the first highlighted '담벼락에서 공개 규탄'. Bottom strip: five cat portrait medallions connected by relationship lines, one line between the black cat and the orange tabby cut by red claw marks. Clock '21:07' in cold blue. Cute faces, cold power game mood, film grain, heavy vignette. Continuity constraints: no calendar dates or years anywhere, only the clock "21:07"; the torn treaty is titled "차 밑 통행 협정" between 까망이 (바다장화파, teal) and 치즈 (노을 마당파); the five factions and leaders are the same as screen A: 바다장화파·까망이, 노을 마당파·치즈, 성당 언덕파·삼색이, 생선가게파·점박이, 계단 쉼터파·꼬물이; the teal 바다장화파 zone invades the 생선가게파 zone.
